item.text: I found the scope leak in the shared URL maps: restoration looks up placeholders without checking which message stored them. I also found that the mail Markdown renderer disables lists, and the cleanup removes indentation from ordered lists. I’m updating those paths and passing the composer’s ID through generation, preview, and insertion.
